research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Mandiant is engaged in developing advanced machine learning techniques for cybersecurity. One area of focus is churn-aware training of classifiers, which aims to minimize prediction discrepancies between different model generations, enhancing threat detection capabilities. Another area involves training machine learning models to infer file properties and detect threats, utilizing labeled datasets to improve cybersecurity measures. These efforts highlight Mandiant's commitment to advancing incident response and forensic solutions through innovative machine learning applications.

overview_description.description:
Mandiant is the information security industry's leading provider of incident response and computer forensics solutions and services. Headquartered in Alexandria, Virginia, with offices in New York, Los Angeles, and San Francisco, Mandiant provides products, professional services, and education to Fortune 500 companies, financial institutions, government agencies, domestic and foreign police departments, and U.S. law firms.

Mandiant comprises the industry's largest incident response and forensics forces. The authors of nine books, Mandiant security consultants and engineers hold top government security clearances and certifications and advanced degrees from some of the most prestigious computer science universities.

about_short_description.short_description: Mandiant is an information security company that provides incident response and computer forensic solutions and services.

product.name: Mandiant Incident Response
product.description: Incident response services for investigating, containing, and recovering from cyberattacks, including technical response, preparedness, crisis management, and compromise assessments.

product.name: Mandiant Managed Defense
product.description: A 24/7 managed detection and response service that monitors environments, investigates suspicious activity, and helps organizations contain and eliminate threats.

product.name: Mandiant Retainer
product.description: A flexible incident response retainer providing pre-negotiated access to cybersecurity experts, rapid response support, and proactive services to improve breach readiness.

product.name: Mandiant Threat Intelligence Services
product.description: Threat intelligence consulting that provides customized research, analyst expertise, intelligence capability development, and guidance for applying threat intelligence to security operations.

product.name: Mandiant Cybersecurity Consulting
product.description: Advisory and implementation services that improve cyber risk management, resilience, security operations, technical controls, and organizational readiness before and after incidents.

product.name: Mandiant Technical Assurance
product.description: Offensive security and technical testing services that use realistic attacker behavior to identify weaknesses in security controls, architectures, and response capabilities.
